intuition: A triplet with any coordinate above the target can never be used in a coordinate-wise maximum.

brute_force.approach: Try every subset of triplets and compute its coordinate-wise maximum.

optimal.approach: Ignore overshooting triplets and record which target coordinates are matched by the remaining candidates.

edge_cases: One target coordinate may be supplied by a different triplet than the others.
A candidate exceeding even one target coordinate must be ignored.
